```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
import markdown
from html import escape
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# ==========================================================
# LOAD CONTENT
# ==========================================================

with open("../../content/totaltool-closure-rules.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

nav = data.get("navigation", {})
hero = data.get("hero", {})
conservation = data.get("conservation_area", {})
standing = data.get("standing_rule", {})
total = data.get("total_tool", {})
references = data.get("references", {})


# ==========================================================
# HELPERS
# ==========================================================

def safe(value):
    return escape(
        str(value if value is not None else ""),
        quote=True
    )


def md(value):
    """Render CMS-managed Markdown, including inline links."""
    return markdown.markdown(
        str(value or ""),
        extensions=["tables", "sane_lists"]
    )


def render_paragraphs(items):
    return "\n".join(
        md(item if isinstance(item, str) else item.get("text", ""))
        for item in (items or [])
    )


def page_url(value):
    """Convert local QMD links to rendered HTML links."""
    parts = urlsplit(str(value or ""))

    if parts.path.endswith(".qmd"):
        parts = parts._replace(
            path=parts.path[:-4] + ".html"
        )

    return urlunsplit(parts)


def render_image(image):
    image = image or {}

    if not image.get("path"):
        return ""

    caption = image.get("caption", "")
    caption_html = (
        f"<figcaption>{md(caption)}</figcaption>"
        if caption else ""
    )

    return f"""
    <figure class="cw-totaltool-rules-figure">
      <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-image-frame">
        <img
          src="{safe(image.get('path'))}"
          alt="{safe(image.get('alt'))}"
          loading="lazy"
        >
      </div>
      {caption_html}
    </figure>
    """


def section_heading(title, eyebrow=""):
    eyebrow_html = (
        f'<span class="cw-totaltool-rules-kicker">{safe(eyebrow)}</span>'
        if eyebrow else ""
    )

    return f"""
    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-heading">
      {eyebrow_html}
      <h2>{safe(title)}</h2>
    </div>
    """


# ==========================================================
# NAVIGATION
# ==========================================================

nav_links = ""

for link in nav.get("links", []):
    target = page_url(link.get("url"))

    active = (
        urlsplit(target).path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        == "totaltool-closure-rules.html"
    )

    nav_links += f"""
    <a
      class="cw-totaltool-rules-tab{' is-active' if active else ''}"
      href="{safe(target)}"
      {'aria-current="page"' if active else ''}
    >
      {safe(link.get('label'))}
    </a>
    """


# ==========================================================
# ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITION CARDS
# ==========================================================

condition_cards = ""

for index, condition in enumerate(
    standing.get("conditions", []),
    start=1
):
    condition_cards += f"""
    <article class="cw-totaltool-rules-condition-card">

      <span class="cw-totaltool-rules-condition-index">
        CONDITION {index:02d}
      </span>

      <h3>{safe(condition.get('title'))}</h3>

      <p>{safe(condition.get('description'))}</p>

    </article>
    """


# ==========================================================
# REFERENCES
# ==========================================================

reference_items = ""

for item in references.get("items", []):
    reference_items += f"""
    <li>
      {safe(item.get('citation'))}
      <a
        href="{safe(item.get('url'))}"
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
      >
        {safe(item.get('link_label'))}
      </a>
    </li>
    """


# ==========================================================
# PAGE HTML
# ==========================================================

html = f"""
<div class="cw-totaltool-rules">

  <!-- =====================================================
       PROJECT NAVIGATION
       ===================================================== -->

  <header class="cw-totaltool-rules-topbar">

    <a class="cw-totaltool-rules-brand" href="totaltool.html">

      <span class="cw-totaltool-rules-brand-name">
        {safe(nav.get('brand', 'TOTAL'))}
      </span>

      <span class="cw-totaltool-rules-brand-subtitle">
        {safe(nav.get('brand_subtitle'))}
      </span>

    </a>

    <nav class="cw-totaltool-rules-tabs"
         aria-label="TOTAL navigation">
      {nav_links}
    </nav>

  </header>


  <!-- =====================================================
       HERO
       ===================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-rules-hero">

    <span class="cw-totaltool-rules-hero-eyebrow">
      {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
    </span>

    <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

    <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>

  </section>


  <!-- =====================================================
       LOGGERHEAD CONSERVATION AREA
       ===================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-rules-section">

    {section_heading(
        conservation.get('title'),
        conservation.get('eyebrow')
    )}

    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-intro-panel">
      {render_paragraphs(conservation.get('paragraphs'))}
    </div>

    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-media">
      {render_image(conservation.get('image'))}
    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- =====================================================
       STANDING CLOSURE RULE
       ===================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-rules-section">

    {section_heading(
        standing.get('title'),
        standing.get('eyebrow')
    )}

    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-reading">
      {render_paragraphs(standing.get('introduction'))}
    </div>

    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-conditions-grid">
      {condition_cards}
    </div>

    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-reading">
      {render_paragraphs(standing.get('explanation'))}
    </div>

    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-season">

      <span class="cw-totaltool-rules-season-label">
        {safe(standing.get('period_label'))}
      </span>

      <strong class="cw-totaltool-rules-season-dates">
        {safe(standing.get('period'))}
      </strong>

      <p>{safe(standing.get('period_note'))}</p>

    </div>

    <p class="cw-totaltool-rules-closure-label">
      {safe(standing.get('closing_text'))}
    </p>

  </section>


  <!-- =====================================================
       PROPOSED TOTAL BYCATCH AVOIDANCE TOOL
       ===================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-rules-section">

    {section_heading(
        total.get('title'),
        total.get('eyebrow')
    )}

    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-reading">
      {render_paragraphs(total.get('paragraphs'))}
    </div>

    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-threshold">

      <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-threshold-number">

        <span class="cw-totaltool-rules-threshold-label">
          {safe(total.get('threshold_label'))}
        </span>

        <strong class="cw-totaltool-rules-threshold-value">
          {safe(total.get('threshold'))}
        </strong>

      </div>

      <p>{safe(total.get('threshold_note'))}</p>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-media">
      {render_image(total.get('image'))}
    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- =====================================================
       ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
       ===================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-rules-section">

    {section_heading(
        references.get('heading'),
        references.get('eyebrow')
    )}

    <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-accordion">

      <details class="cw-totaltool-rules-details">

        <summary>
          {safe(references.get('title', 'References'))}
          <span aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </summary>

        <div class="cw-totaltool-rules-details-body">

          <ul>
            {reference_items}
          </ul>

        </div>

      </details>

    </div>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
